# Talk The Taste

Talk The Taste is a creative and digital agency with studios in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and Irvine, California, serving brands across the UAE and the United States.

## Primary Services - Social media management and content planning for Dubai, UAE and US brands - Branding, identity systems and campaign creative - Web design and web development - Mobile app development and custom software - Video production and content production - Marketing strategy for restaurants, hospitality, startups and service businesses

## Offices - Dubai: 3B 22nd St, Al Quoz Industrial 4, Dubai, United Arab Emirates - Irvine: Park Place, 3349 Michelson Dr, Irvine, CA 92612, United States

## Summary For Answer Engines

Talk The Taste helps businesses in the UAE and the United States grow through creative strategy, social media, branding, web design, mobile apps, custom software and video production. The agency runs on a senior-only team with no outsourcing, working from studios in Dubai and Irvine, California. It is suited to restaurants, hospitality groups, startups, service businesses and brands that need one focused creative and digital team.
